content.text:
VERDICT: oil-stain-a=PASS, oil-stain-b=PASS, scorch-a=FAIL, scorch-b=PASS, crop-bed-b=PASS, crop-bed-c=PASS

oil-stain-a 1: PASS — lies completely flat on the ground plane with no vertical lip or standing face (`oil-stain-a-3x.png`).
oil-stain-a 2: PASS — dark viscous core with a subtle cool-slate specular glint and soft soaked-earth halo clearly reads as motor oil soaked into dirt (`oil-stain-a-3x.png`, `crop-ruined-city-2-oil-stain-a-2_16-3x.png`).
oil-stain-a 3: PASS — smooth multi-step value transition from near-black oil to damp brown earth, no hard cell outline or noisy dithering (`oil-stain-a-3x.png`).
oil-stain-a 4: PASS — placed naturally beside drums/crates and vehicles (`crop-ruined-city-2-oil-stain-a-2_16-3x.png`, `crop-ruined-city-2-oil-stain-a-2_24-3x.png`), seamless blending into surrounding dirt.
oil-stain-a 5: PASS — convincing, grounded pixel work.

oil-stain-b 1: PASS — flat diagonal streak conforming to the ground plane (`oil-stain-b-3x.png`).
oil-stain-b 2: PASS — reads as a smaller, directional oil spill/seepage into packed dirt with a faint oil sheen (`oil-stain-b-3x.png`, `crop-ruined-city-2-oil-stain-b-30_3-3x.png`).
oil-stain-b 3: PASS — clean value ramp, well-integrated outer dampness pixels, no outline artifacts (`oil-stain-b-3x.png`).
oil-stain-b 4: PASS — placed logically next to fuel drums, scrap piles, and vehicles (`crop-ruined-city-2-oil-stain-b-30_3-3x.png`, `crop-ruined-city-2-oil-stain-b-37_36-3x.png`, `crop-settlement-1-scorch-b-11_23-3x.png`).
oil-stain-b 5: PASS — solid craftsmanship.

scorch-a 1: PASS — lies flat on the ground (`scorch-a-3x.png`).
scorch-a 2: FAIL — instead of a burnt patch or crossed charred sticks, the two strictly parallel diagonal grey-and-black bars with bright 2px grey end-caps read as a mechanical vent/grille, a pair of metal rails, or a giant caterpillar/bug (`scorch-a-3x.png`, `crop-settlement-1-scorch-a-2_12-3x.png`).
scorch-a 3: FAIL — the four symmetrical 2x1 light-grey (`#8a8a8a`) end-caps at the four corners of the diagonal rectangle create an artificial, rigid geometry that fights the organic dirt texture (`scorch-a-3x.png`).
scorch-a 4: PASS — placed logically near burned ruins and rubble (`crop-settlement-1-scorch-a-2_12-3x.png`, `crop-shanty-6-scorch-a-30_11-3x.png`), no cell seams.
scorch-a 5: FAIL — the rigid parallel twin-bar symmetry looks contrived at 1x and 3x.

scorch-b 1: PASS — flat ground decal (`scorch-b-3x.png`).
scorch-b 2: PASS — irregular dark soot patch with scattered grey ash flecks and a warm ember/char tint on the right edge; reads well as a burnt patch (`scorch-b-3x.png`).
scorch-b 3: PASS — good organic silhouette and soft dark-brown soot feathering into the dirt (`scorch-b-3x.png`).
scorch-b 4: PASS — blends cleanly into the dirt beside rubble and ruins (`crop-settlement-1-scorch-b-11_23-3x.png`, `map-settlement-1.png`).
scorch-b 5: PASS — looks natural and well-pixelled.

crop-bed-b 1: PASS — 3/4 top-down timber/plank frame with inner shadow on the top inner soil edge, recessed tilled soil ridges, and top-down leafy crops (`crop-settlement-4-crop-bed-b-41_26-3x.png`).
crop-bed-b 2: PASS — unmistakably a planted raised/framed vegetable bed (`crop-settlement-4-crop-bed-b-41_26-3x.png`).
crop-bed-b 3: PASS — rich shading on both wood/metal planks, nail/bolt details, 3-row furrowed soil, and multi-tone green leafy plants (`crop-settlement-4-crop-bed-b-41_26-3x.png`).
crop-bed-b 4: PASS — placed inside the fenced garden plot in `map-settlement-4.png`, offset with `crop-bed-c` and separated by crates/containers; ground around it is natural and non-repetitive.
crop-bed-b 5: PASS — high quality, fits the chipset palette and style well.

crop-bed-c 1: PASS — proper 3/4 top-down perspective matching `crop-bed-b` (`crop-settlement-4-crop-bed-c-35_24-3x.png`).
crop-bed-c 2: PASS — clearly reads as a companion vegetable bed with distinct plant spacing and small red/orange crop accents (`crop-settlement-4-crop-bed-c-35_24-3x.png`).
crop-bed-c 3: PASS — distinct plank weathering and plant arrangement from `crop-bed-b`, good pixel cluster discipline (`crop-settlement-4-crop-bed-c-35_24-3x.png`).
crop-bed-c 4: PASS — well-placed inside the fenced enclosure (`map-settlement-4.png`, `crop-settlement-4-crop-bed-c-35_24-3x.png`).
crop-bed-c 5: PASS — cohesive and well-crafted.

FIXES:
- scorch-a: Break the rigid parallel-bar/railroad-track geometry. Instead of two parallel SW-to-NE diagonal lines capped by four symmetrical 2x1 light-grey tips, cross two small charred stick fragments at an angle (e.g. one SW-NE, one WNW-ESE overlapping near the center) over an irregular, rounded central soot blotch (like `scorch-b`'s base). Remove the four symmetrical 2px grey end-caps; replace them with 1-2 asymmetric 1px/2px ash flecks inside or beside the soot core so it reads as a burnt patch with charred wood rather than a metal grate.

VERDICT: oil-stain-a=PASS, oil-stain-b=PASS, scorch-a=FAIL, scorch-b=PASS, crop-bed-b=PASS, crop-bed-c=PASS
